name: Tsuma Emiko
source:
My Wife, Emiko, had given birth to our first child, and we all lived happily as a family of 3 until one day...

The company I was working for went bankrupt after a scandal broke.
While trying to understand the scandal and all that happened, as well as find a job, my wife...
my wife said she'd get a job to support our family while I was looking for new work.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032481.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的妻子绘美子刚刚生下第一个孩子，我们一家三口原本幸福地生活着，直到某一天……

我工作的公司因丑闻曝光而破产。在我努力弄清丑闻始末、同时寻找新工作时，妻子……
我的妻子说，在我找到新工作之前，她会出去工作，支撑这个家。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032481.html]DLsite English[/url]]
